title: Terrible service...terrible app
text: Map locations are wrong, their emergency response team almost let my father die.  Don't trust this app or their promised service.

title: Horrible update!
text: The app used to work reasonably well for us until the last update. Location information no longer displays and you pay extra to have family link. They need to fix the app or refund the money we pay for the service.

title: DO NOT UPDATE!
text: This update will only let you see battery status and a list of past calls to Great Call. It is a major Fail.

title: Latest version breaks features with Splash device!
text: After upgrading to this version, I now only get the battery status and # of 5 Star calls made for a Splash device.  All other features are now gone! GPS location and week in review are no longer available as they were with the previous version. I thought new versions are intended to improve on things not take features away!  Big fail Great Call!

title: Update took it from poor to non-working
text: Recent update has made the app non-functional.

title: Does not work
text: I had an app on the old device that did not have fall protection and it worked fine. The new app for the fall protection device doesn't work at all no matter how many times I've contacted the company they still can't make it work.

title: Unreliable
text: Not very reliable.  Move device from one room to another and tells all I am out.  Needs a lot of work.  Also takes too long to update location.

title: Great idea; poor functionality
text: GPS very often does not work at all. When it does work updates are in frequent. For example, it tells me my mom was out and about 2 1/2 hours ago. That's a long time to go without an update! The Help staff usually does try to be helpful; I just think the system needs a lot of improvement.

title: Not impressed
text:
Bought great call Splash with ultimate plan for my mother and Aunt.  Tested the devices and response time was under 10 seconds.  Great. Charge lasted several days. Good. Then I turned on fall protection.  When fall protection was turned on the battery life significantly decreased.  I have to recharge it after about 13-15 hours. Not good, and the rep told me that was standard for fall protection. I will have to turn off auto fall protection to keep the device on my moms neck and off of the cradle. The Great Call Link app is UNRELIABLE. It always shows battery charging, even when it's not on the charger.  The device status ALWAYS displays ON even when I've turned it off for the better part of the day.  The GPS seems to be working fine for the most part. The ability to check the device ALWAYS returns a server error.  I wish I could rely on this app but I can't.

Update:  The battery display appears to be working. Other than the GPS nothing else is working. My mom pressed the button. I thought I would get notified. Instead, that event became a tiny note in the app.  Summaries appear in reverse chronological order. I would not recommend paying extra for this app. The latest version did nothing to fix prior issues.

title: CRO
text: App completely untrustworthy worked one day. Then would close as soon as screen tried to refresh without showing any info. Ran the latest update now it won't show anything but the sign on screen and the company info block. Can't access any tracking info at all.

title: Not reliable
text: When this app works, it does a great job of tracking the phone user, and the mapping is accurate. Lately, it has been unable to locate the user or tells me the device is not on. This, even when I'm TALKING to the user on the land line, and she's confirming that her cell phone is on and charged. May be a network problem on Great Calls side, but since the main reason I got the Jitterbug phone for my 88 year old mom was to be able to track her, these outages are completely unacceptable.

title: Both frustrated user and bad experience user names were taken, how bad could it be?
text: Like a lot of customers have complained already - it only works for a few days, then everything stopped working. The 5*, the GPS, the battery indication, the greatcall link app, and, the customer service. They don't know the basics and they gave an impression that the Estimated fix time is just beyond your grace period. How can one rely on this for a life saving aid device for the elder-lies?

title: Love it
text: Love that I can keep track of my aunt. Also… knowing The devices charged and being used and is on perfect also love knowing when she's leaving the house and returns gives me peace of mind.

title: iPhone / iPad
text: Worked great for 2 years. Now it works on my iPad but not much on my iPhone 6. Keeps telling the unit is off or trouble connecting to server on iPhone but works fine on iPad.

title: Works now
text:
It seems as though, after I wrote a poor review
out of frustration, the app seems to work. So I added 2 stars to my original review. This is great as long as it works.

title: Needs an overhaul.
text:
Update- The app has not updated its status (battery level, locations, weekly reports, 5 star call info, etc.) since May 12th. It's now June 9th. 

The concept for the app is great. The functionality is lacking. You can't track more than one account (though that issue to me is bigger than the app since you can't have more than one person on an account). The locations are a bit buggy (the app likes to notify me often that my mother is in random places between 4-5am when I see that she's in bed asleep any time she actually leaves the home it tells me nothing). It is constantly showing that the device is charging even when she's wearing it. Rarely does it notify me that she's out and about; in fact most of the notifications never show up (except for those random places at 4-5 in the morning). It's slow; everything you try to do on the app is slow no matter your phone or connection. For the most part, I feel that it needs to be more functional. After all, more times than not the people using the app are not the ones wearing the devices/using the phones so it doesn't need to simplified so much that nothing works and what does work has little to no options for use.

title: App crashes
text: Loaded app in IPhone 6 - sign in and app crashes - link support has not been able to help. One month - worthless if not able to track

title: GPS Stinks
text: Although I love the concept, in reality the GPS stinks! My 85 yr old mother has the splash. The app's GPS shows my mother being out and about all through the middle of the night when she's home in bed sleeping. This can be extremely frightening to loved ones. I've gotten Calls at 3am from concerned siblings!! Need to fix thi!

title: Unreliable
text: I had high hopes for this app, but as others have stated, it needs a major overhaul. Unreliable, says it's charging when it's around my mom's neck, says she's out and about the day AFTER she was actually out and about, weekly update doesn't update - I could go on and on. Being able to have all of her medications, dosages etc at hand is a feature plus, but using the app to keep up with my mom is useless.

title: Quit Working
text: This app worked the first few months but then stopped tracking. More often than not, the app shows the phone is off or not in service when, in fact, it is on and fully charged.

title: Limited tracking
text: We bought this phone, not for an elder parent, but for our 13-year old son to use as his communication device when we need to take away his iPhone for disciplinary reasons.  For that purpose, it's fine. (It's actually a very humiliating phone for a teenager to carry around!)  But it does not offer the kind of real-time whereabouts information that the iPhone provides.  The "Jitterbug" only seems to ping the location server every 20 minutes or so.  When you need to know where your kid is right now, a message like "About 15 minutes ago Junior was out and about" is quite frustrating.

title: False Battery indicator and GPS function not working on Great Call Link
text: Software unstable. Great Call has a problem with reporting the correct battery state. It also says the phone is offline and it is not. It is online with a good signal.

title: Junk
text: Junk

title: Has issues but just ok
text:
I have this and am disappointed in the problem of 1/2 the time it says it's not in service. I keep having to remove and put the app back on again on my phone and/or get my dad's phone and reboot it. Need to work on this to make it work better and the location issue needs to be more accurate. I hope someone from jitterbug can work on this and soon
Update...still needs a lot of work. Doesn't give correct info on location..regardless how much I remove and add the app, turn off and on my dad's phone still gives erroneous info. Now phone is always charging, even when it's not. Please fix these bugs--we have these apps for our loved ones but can't count on it to be accurate

title: Forget it
text: I bought this device with high hope that it would solve a problem with a 91 year old live alone dad out in the boonies. I was happy with it for the first few days then it went to crap. The app now shows the Splash is always in the charger, it always shows the power is on even when turned off for 30 minutes. For the last few days it always shows he is at home when I know he is not. I've been in touch with tech support many times.  The standard answer is turn it off turn it on maybe it will work by tomorrow.  Or better yet, "are you at home?  The device says your at home so that's ok." That's all it ever says these days.

title: App doesn't show location
text: Since I bought the phone for my father, the app doesn't show where he is. It always gives me an error saying that the device is not activated or 5star are having issues. It's been 2 weeks since and they still have not fixed it. This is the only reason I got this phone for my father. Really disappointed. Customer service keeps telling me it will take a couple of days to fix the issue and still not working 2 weeks later.

title: Inconsistent
text: For something this important the app gives false readings on battery life and on/off line.  It also indicates my Mom is Out and About often miles away when she hasn't moved outside her very small house.. In addition it indicates she hasn't used the fob for several days as if that's a bad thing.  When we press the button the app ultimately wakes up but it is unnerving.  We will have to look for more secure solutions.

title: Love My GreatLink
text: I was a bit hesitant to get the "GreatCall Splash" because I am JUST under 50. However, due to my medical conditions I am in dire need of something so my husband and daughter know I'm safe. My daughter loves that she gets notifications letting her know where I am! I haven't had ANY negative issues that I know of. The only problem I have is I clip the unit to my purse, and if I place it down carelessly, it thinks there's been a "Fall Detected" and I have to press the button right away to interrupt the call. It happens A LOT.

title: Peace of Mind
text:
This app gave my Mother such peace of mind.  Knowing that I know where she is at any moment, when she leaves home and keeps me updated continuously.

I wanted this for my benefit because of the GPS tracking and the falling feature-  and when she agreed I was thrilled. We both feel relief and peace of mind.

title: Keeping mom safe - Splash + Great Call service
text:
I live in a different state and use the system as a safeguard to ensure my 89 year old mother is safe at home. I primarily use the app to locate her and it works well in Phoenix. I can distinguish between her being in the backyard or in the house, or any other location she chooses to travel to in the area. It helps balance her independence and safety. 
I highly recommend Great Call service and the app for aging parents. The single button system is easy to use in an emergency or if she simply isn't feeling well. Thwy have her history and all relevant contact info. They know to call me if she has asked for help.

title: Not as good as some locators
text: The device does not update as quickly as a newer generation smart phone and either the device or the app result in showing a wrong location. When she is at home, the app shows her several hundred feet from her condo. If this were a single family home in a residential neighborhood, I would not worry so much but when it is a multi storied multi condo unit, I would worry that any first responders would be  misled. Last Sunday when she was in church, the app showed her on the fairway of one of the holes of a nearby golf course. I got a kick out of that! Bottom line, get Grandma an iPhone with "Find My Friends"

title: GreatCall no link
text: I have yet to be able to connect to the phone to utilize any of the functions listed :(. Very, very disappointed to always see "no status"

title: Very pleased.
text: My mother bought this for my father who had a few falls.  They are happier knowing that if something happens someone is there to get them help.  I feel less anxious being able to get updates with the app.

title: Fulfills the Purpose
text: I am pleased that this fulfills the purpose: I can monitor my 85 year-old aunt's whereabouts from across the country.  But the weekly updates are not kept in reverse chronological order and if there is a problem between the device and the App, I've always had to delete the App (and all the data) to correct the problem.  I don't think there is a better system out there; I really don't.  I just wish the data they collect through the GPS would be more thorough.

title: Excellent app - does what it says!
text: Excellent app - does what it says!

title: Too buggy.....
text: App remains very error prone. Don't have much choice, I would not say the developers are good at what they do.  You are stuck, however, if family chooses to use this service.

title: Bought one for mother in law also
text: My mom had the early version. Got the Splash for my mother in law. The app lets us keep tabs on her activities. Great to know she can push a button for help. AND YES it does work that way. Thank you Great Call.

title: Great device
text: Excellent customer service. App works great.

title: Device is not all it advertises itself to be
text: The daily activity list is totally useless, it just does not work at all. I have programmed in seven of my mother's favorite places to go. Over the past week I have been testing it out by going to all of these places, and a device registers NOTHING but "Out and About"!!!!!!!

title: Good enough
text: I'm still new to this device and service. We chose it because my wife has aphasia from a stroke. The lanyard to charger transition is hard for her. I'm not sure the gps is good enough to locate my wife if she falls while away from home and her speech is impaired.

title: Device
text: Device works great customer service on the phone very helpful company people highly would recommend

title: 5 star service great, app not so much
text: I love the service. The app said Hubby contacted 5 star & he hadn't. I just hope app tracks him if he wanders off 😬

title: Not accurate information. Needs improvement
text: The tracking is not as accurate as I would have thought. They ballpark locations of phone. It will read that the phone was home 55 minutes ago and it was 10 miles away at that time. The app will say the user actively used the phone once last week and The user is calling me 4-5 day on that phone. Go figure. All information in general needs to be update much more often..for safety reasons if not anything else.

title: Unfortunately, needs improvement
text:
Location accuracy is unreliable and often very inaccurate. Also, it shows "Out and about" and "battery is charging" messages simultaneously - (only charger we have is the supplied cradle which is used exclusively at home)
Like the concept of the app - just wish it supplied us with information that we could trust.

title: Only works part of the time
text:
Got this for my aging mother so I could keep track of her coming and goings. I had a feeling the app wasn't working quite right...my mom would tell me she had gone shopping yet the app never notified me. Another time I was notified that she left the house at 2:15am and returned at 4:30am. I asked her where she'd been and she said sleeping. Again the app was wrong. 
I don't know, but I sure hope Great Call see's all these comments everyone has written so they know there are issues with the app, devises and GPS system; it's not the user with the issue, especially when the same thing keeps happening over and over to different users.

title: TERRIBLE!
text: This app never works, it shuts down every time I try to open it. PLEASE fix it!

title: Agree
text: Agree with all the other poor reviews. This sounds like such a good deal, with great things to help with caring for our aging parents. But I'm not convinced, that this will be anything other than a returned product and discontinuation of use.

title: Needs work!
text: The device works great!! The app and the he website needs a LOT of work.

title: Terrible
text:
Worked the first day and that was it. Now it always says the 5 star device may be off or not in service but when you look at the phone it's fine. So far he has been out a few times but it doesn't tell me that. The first day this app told me his battery status but that stopped too. I think having 5 star on his phone uses way too much battery also. He charged it this morning and hasn't used it all day and when I just went to his house it was at 40%. 
Basically this app is useless

title: Splash
text: This service need some work, I have my mother on the unit but there have been times that I received a message stating that she could not be located( what am I paying for?) The message also give bad locations some time up to ten miles away when she is sitting in her house. The tech stated that google maps showed the wrong location, I contacted google maps, reworked their location but the link is still getting things wrong. There has been times that I received messages that her unit is turned off, I call her and the unit is on but the link is not working. When it work it is good, but the question is "when it work?"

title: Really?
text: Does not work all the time. Not a good purchase if you really need something to work for an elderly person.

title: Ugh!
text: Just bought the Splash product for my mom and downloaded this app. It hasn't been able to connect to servers for days!! Don't they test their app before launching it??

title: Safety
text: I am so happy to have this safety button.  Leaving the house and hanging around gives freedom.

title: Mr
text:
Terrible quality!  Tells me the splash is off yet test calls work ok. Multiple "server errors".  

Not ready for prime time.

title: Great link
text: I find this app very helpful to monitor my moms great cal splash device.

title: Great tool
text: This app coupled with the god units my parents have gives me great relief. It allows me to know where my parents are without being intrusive.

title: App does not work
text: I don't understand why an app so important has not been kept up and ensured that it is functioning and accurate. Many people depend on this app to make sure their loved ones are safe. Please fix this and make sure it remains functioning and updated.

title: Great - when it works
text: The app is great for helping to keep track of the whereabouts of my memory impaired father. Sadly however, it frequently loses the connection with my father's phone for no apparent reason. Then the app displays the message that "the 5 star device may be off or not in service". This happens even when his device is on and working properly from a phone standpoint.  This is the main reason we purchased the Jitterbug phone, so we could keep track of Dad and his whereabouts.  So sorry this app is not dependable and requires lots of time and tech service to get it working again. Hope this can be fixed.

title: Awesom app !
text:
This is a must have ! 
I'm able to know how moms doing and to let her know if she needs to charge her devise . They are super fast to respond when she pushes her call button ! 
Well worth having and I've put the word out to others about 5 star Great call. I defiantly recommend this to all. 
Thank you Great call for the piece of mind I now have

title: Very frustrating! Poor service! Don't waste your money!!!
text: Very dissatisfied with purchase of great-talk splash necklace device. Would only stay charged maybe a day, the device was on the charger longer than on the person which defeats the purpose of use! This is for the fall detection. The app does not work well and has not shown me the battery life at all!!! Location not accurate. Customer service told me that my expectations was not in line with service. Well, I only expect to pay for a device that works. Sorry! Not a fan, please look into other medical devices before wasting time and money like me!

title: Frustrating App!
text: This app is driving me crazy!  Very disappointed. It works sporadically and it's very unreliable. I live over 400 miles away from my 91 year old mother, and was hoping this app would provide me with some level of comfort in keeping connected to her when I'm not physically talking to her on the phone. It initially worked well, but shortly after started giving inaccurate information. It would indicate that my mother left home at 1:15 a.m. and returned at 1:45 a.m.  My mother lives alone and doesn't drive. Now I'm getting a message that says the device is turned off or not in service.  I've called support and I'm told the app is rarely wrong. The concept behind this app is great so I hope they find a way to fix these issues. I sure hope her actual device is functioning far more accurately than the smart phone app!

title: Disappointing GPS
text:
I looked forward to being able to know when my mom was out and about and then safely home but the GPS function is terrible.  Inaccurate location info.  Others have noted the delay in updates, which I am willing to allow for in order to limit the battery drain. But the lack of accuracy is not acceptable. The app has said mom has traveled a mile or more from home when she had not left the house all day. And other times it did not record a trip she did take. Very disappointed in this functionality.   

It does seem to be accurate on the battery level, however. I'm hoping they will work on the other issues as this app could be extremely useful to family members and other caregivers.

title: Great Call
text: My 87 year old mother lives 2000 miles from me and this lets me know she is OK-she feels more secure knowing she can get help anytime.

title: Doesn't work
text: Hasn't worked in a week and a half. Updated today and still not working.

title: Needs some serious work!
text: Got my 86 year old mother a Jitterbug5 cause she needed a simpler phone, and I loved the option of having her GPS location via the app.  You should know that the GPS is only updated a few times an hour unless the "5Star" button is called, in which case it's updated every few seconds.  Even so, the map locator seems to work fairly well. However, the other features (being able to see battery level & status of phone) have only worked (i.e. shown up in my iPhone app) 2 days in the month and a half she's had it.  Nearly always says "the 5Star device may be off or not in service" - even when I am standing there holding the turned-on phone.  Very disappointing since we changed her phone service to Great Call (which cost more than the plan she had had) specifically to have this information.  We'll see.

title: Love this service
text: We have this for a loved one Lets you know when  they are out of the home and when they return . The greatcall service is extra piece of mind knowing they can contact emergency service and I will be notified in real time

title: Don't expect to find them
text: The Great Call link rarely works and when it does it's not right. Don't get this if you want to track someone. You will never find them.....

title: Terrible app
text: Contact is difficult-- when pt is disabled such as cannot hear on telephone-- app is totally unusable-- scrap this hunk of junk and start over

title: Great potential
text: This app has great potential, but it's been hit and miss in reliability. It will say it can't connect to the server and the device may be off when it has just sent me a status update. I would love it if they get the bugs worked out.

title: Great all
text: This device seems to be what we need for our mom. Hopefully we will never have to use it. It give us a piece of mind to know when we are not with her, she has some backup.

title: So far, so good
text: Good service and excellent app for monitoring the parent when I am away.  I am worried about the battery that keeps showing half a charge when it has charged for nearly week solid without being taken off the charger, we shall see.

title: Good App
text: Have been using this app for about two months and so far it's functioned as I expected.

title: Great Call
text: We have received great customer support. The wait time to speak with a representative has been very reasonable. The support team has always been patient and helpful answering my questions. I especially like the fact this product is waterproof and durable.

title: As RN, will be recommending to my patients
text: After a great deal of research I selected this device for my mom who lives with me and is home alone during my long shifts at work while, ironically, I take care of everyone else's mom.  I love that this app lets me check in on her & make sure she's wearing the device, and see if she's been up & around without having to call several times a day.  Also great for updating her meds and just the peace of knowing that if she should fall and not be able to speak, help will still come.  She won't face lying on the floor for hours until I got home.  Worth every penny.

title: Peace of mind
text: So good someone can be there virtually when it's not possible to be there physically -and I can check in! Awesome!!!

title: Splash link
text: I love being able to check on my mothers device status and power. The location feature is also handy if she were to get lost.

title: Peace of Mind app for knowing your loved one is safe.
text:
This app allows you to know that status of your loved one 24 hours a day!  It's priceless. I'm 424 miles from my 90 year old Mother and I can even tell when the device needs to be charged. It can be used to locate someone that becomes lost if they are unable to communicate with you or others. 
A must have!

title: Daughter of a mobile mother
text: Great calls and it's app is the best service ever! If I put in known addresses the app tells me when she's there. It lets me know that her battery is charged and whether it is in the charging cradle (and therefore not on her person). It would also let me know if she made an emergency call or a fall is detected. The service delivers great peace of mind!!

title: Love, love, love it
text: My elderly mother is in a different state and I got her this for her as she lives alone.  The app lets me know when she is out and about, home and when she has used her device to emergency services. Helps keep my sanity in check and I could not live without it.

title: Works as promised: thrilled
text: Got a Jitterbug5 for my 89 year old dad who still gets out and about and needs an easy phone to use with an emergency panic button. The link app has worked flawlessly on my iPhone and always locates him within 30 feet: Love being able to locate him at any time. We have very good Verizon coverage in our area and maybe others have had spotty coverage, but I LOVE this app. I just checked to see that he got to his volunteer position . Never had a problem with support.

title: Works great
text: No problems so far and easy to set up.

title: Disappointed
text: Never works. Calling support every week. The app always says out of service or not connected. And cannot locate my mother in law.  That was the point of getting this app.

title: Pretty, but useless
text: I had high hopes for this app to track my aunt.  But it really doesn't do much and the limited functionality that it does have is spotty. Battery levels not accurate and didn't notify me when there was a fall...isn't that the whole point?

title: Great device!
text: Love this medical alert system. After researching all the others this one seemed the best fit for my aunt. It is GPS so she can be found anywhere. I can check on her at anytime and the unit notifies me when she leaves and returns home. It also gives a review of her week and lets me know if she is wearing the alert necklace. I would recommend this to others.

title: Awesome!!!
text: LOVE this application!!! I am SO glad my Gramps got it! Such a cool device with corresponding application! Definitely would recommend to anyone with a older loved-one living on their own.

title: A great app!
text: I'm 75 and live alone.  I'm in great health and am very active.  It's great to have my pendant and know that if I need it I can get help.  The app is a wonderful addition for it.  I can easily check status and so can the links I specify.  What a great way to have peace of mind!

title: This is great!
text: I'm so glad to be able to check on my mother when I am anxious about her safety!

title: Jitterbug, a Great tool
text: Keep tabs on and communication with a loved one while you help them manage their later years.  Very simple, effective.

title: Jitterbug5
text: Bought the Greatcall Jitterbug5 along with the Greatcall Link app. The Greatcall app is exactly what we've been looking for to track our Mom's comings and goings. Awesome peace of mind knowing where she is.

title: Finally a Life alert system that makes sense
text: I purchased this for my mom recently after pricing virtually every system on the market!  I also work in the in home security industry and this is better than what was available on the market at the time. My main reason for purchasing this was the GPS feature that would follow my mom anywhere. Also, with the ultimate pkg I and my siblings can be updated as to Her whereabouts, have the automatic fall detected feature, and on call medical staff.   One of the downfalls of this product is it is a bit large. But, it is an all in one product and my mom doesn't have to remember to take a second piece with her when she leaves the house. A fact that I have noticed in the clients I work with on my job, they forget to take the communicator portion with them when they leave the house!!!!  I highly recommend this product over any system currently available.

title: Mom
text: This app seems to be working good for me. It tracks the few times Mom leaves her apt & gives me weekly reports. Glad I have it.

title: Great reference for device
text: I love this App. It allows me to keep track of my 87 year old father when I am not with him. It shows me when he is out and when he has returned home. It also shows the battery level which is great, I can call him to remind him to charge it. It tells you when the battery is charging , so I can alo call and remind him to put the device back on. This App is great for those who have loved ones wearing this device, it allows you peace of mind

title: Peace of Mind
text: Device works like a charm and accurate to a point on location

title: Needs better accurate updates
text:
I want to love this app but it's not making sense. How can it say I'm out and about while device is charging? 
Maybe I don't understand how to use???
I don't like delay is saying where I am. Wish app would update every few minutes not every 30 minutes. 
I am trying to pick this device or Phillips .

title: So far, so good
text: We got this for my mom because she lives alone. It gives my brother and I more peace of mind.

title: Needs improvements
text: I am using this App and website while I’m going through brain surgery. The website is great, but the app has room for improvement. 1) you can’t see the full calendar. 2) you can’t choose what notifications you get and what notifications you don’t get (like I want to only be notified of pending requests not when people volunteer for something. But that’s not an option). 3) There’s not a way on the app or the website to make a reoccurring task (not just duplicating it but also a way to say “every Monday 7-11am indefinitely). 4) Also, it would be nice on the website and App Calendar if there are multiple tasks in a day but only some tasks have a volunteer and some don’t, for it to be striped grey and pink instead of remaining pink.

title: Horrible App in Time of Need
text: Provides minimal info, slow loading and then it just quit working altogether when my best friend is about to pass and needed most.  Deleted & reinstalling it didn’t help.  Great idea but poor execution

title: Great when it works

Please set the medication recording time to the current time, instead of the reminder time. I stopped using Apple health because I plan to switch to an android device soon. I prefer apps that work for both interfaces.

The user interface is clean and easy to understand, I love the wide variety of symptoms that i can track, and the ability to track appointments. I also like that this app for unnecessary personal information when I downloaded the app. It didn't hit me with a paywall or an ad for its upgraded version either. And I never see ads on this free version! (Maybe that's because of an adblocker I have? But I don't think so)

The fact that they let me know when my phone is on silent mode is a neat bonus as well.

The app is sleek in appearance. It works smoothly, I like its animations and color palette. I've encountered no bugs in the month I've begun to use it, and it's done exactly what I needed it to do. I use MyTherapy, Routinery, and Finch to help me complete my mourning routines and maintain my mental health. The reminders are never annoying, wonderful at standing out amongst my other notifs, and i didn't even have to set them up like that myself.

title: Excellent App! Love the Refill Reminders and the progress charts.
text:
I really rely on the MyTherapy App. I have chronic pancreatitis (CP) with experimental pancreatic insufficiency (EPI) and bile acid malabsorption (BAM). This means I take a lot of medications. Some are scheduled and some are “as needed” depending on my symptoms. 

One of my favorite features is the refill reminders. I log when I get my new prescription and how many pills are in the bottle and have it give me a reminder when I get down to a certain number of pills. 
Now I never run out of medications! Particularly ones that have to be ordered by the pharmacy and not always immediately available. 

Another favorite is the progress charts. They let me see at a glance if I have taken my schedules medications and how much as needed pain and nausea medication I have taken. 

The reports let me give my physician a PDF as needed. And makes it much easier for us to discuss treatment regiments especially in conjunction with the symptoms tracker. 

Support team is also available and responsive within 24 hours. 
Thank you to the App makers for producing and maintaining this critical app. It has been a gamechanger as my disease progresses and helps relieve anxiety over medication and keeps me on track.

BUT: the one and only suggestion I have is specifically for interval medications. If I’m late on my medication, the interval should reflect that! For example, my medication is taken once weekly. If I take my dose on Wednesday, then accidentally don’t take my next dose until Tuesday (13 days later rather than 7), I should not be reminded the very next day to take it again. It should remind me 7 days later.

Anyway, aside from that issue, this is a great app and I highly recommend it to anyone who takes medications and/or vitamins, even if you don’t have trouble remembering to take them!

title: Adhd and busy life: very helpful!
text: I always have had difficulty remembering to take medicine consistently, or remembering if I took it. Now, my doc and I are on a journey trying to figure out which new medicine is going to be a good fit for a new issue. Each different medicine we try has different requirements- morning or night, certain time span before or after other meds, etc. I’m already taking other meds with requirements. This plus a busy lifestyle with many other responsibilities = a brain that can’t always keep up. I’ve tried taking notes on a note app, but it’s clunky to look through a list and try to keep track of everything. This app is perfect for my needs. Simple interface = quick and easy to use. I love that I get a reminder to take meds at the right time, but I get to log it at the time I actually took it. This makes it so much easier to space out the rest of my meds appropriately according to what I actually did. It also helps me remember what I did in the days before, so if I’m consistently off for a while I can slowly make it back to my normal schedule. Thank you to the developers for a great app! Would love if you make one just like it for me to use to keep track of my kids’ meds! When they all get sick, it’s a full time job to keep track of who can take what medicine, what dose, and what time. I love the clean, uncluttered interface of this medication log.

title: Don’t record before reading this
text:
This app may collect audio recordings and transcripts of private medical appointments, and those conversations may be processed by third-party API providers. Before pressing record, users should know exactly where their doctor-patient conversation goes, what is retained, what is deleted, and how this free, venture-backed app plans to make money.

Kin’s privacy materials raise serious questions. Does Kin delete the original audio after transcription? How long are transcripts, summaries, and backups retained? What exact data does Kin keep after each visit? Can Kin use deidentified or aggregated medical conversation data to improve products, analytics, or future models? Can that data ever be shared, transferred, licensed, sold, or used commercially? What happens to user data if Kin is acquired?

Saying third-party providers are restricted from training general-purpose AI models on user data does not answer these core questions. Doctor visits can include diagnoses, prescriptions, mental health, reproductive health, family history, insurance issues, and other deeply personal information.

The privacy disclosure should be impossible to miss before recording begins: whether the audio leaves the phone, whether outside API providers process it, what is stored, what is deleted, how long data is retained, and what rights Kin claims over deidentified or aggregated health data.

Until those answers are clear, users should be very cautious about recording doctor visits with Kin.

title: Decent calendar hindered by cost
text:
With the amount of shared calendars on the App Store it’s difficult to distinguish yourself apart from the rest. TimeTree has a deep set of options with thoughtful features to make planning and organizing relatively easy. While some options are intuitive, others are a bit convoluted and unnecessarily complicated with too many button clicks to achieve a simple task. 

The biggest flaw though is the pricing: $4.50 per month or $45 a year. Again, there are dozens of other shared calendar apps that, more or less, do the same thing with the same features for less money. Why would I pay PER PERSON for a subscription that I will be sharing with one or more people? This is just price gouging for no justifiable reason. No family plans is essentially a deal breaker when other apps offer this kind of subscription and are more inexpensive. 

TimeTree wants to stand out from the pack but they are not doing themselves any favors with their pricing. They are more focused on overcomplicating their app—MORE FEATURES!— while overvaluing their product. People who are paying for this app are getting ripped off and haven’t done their due diligence to look into other, more affordable options.

text:
워낙 깜빡해서 차라리 달력을 상대방과  공유할 수 있으면 좋겠다 생각하던 차에 이 어플을 발견했습니다. 
어느날 캘린더가 갑자기 리셋되어 다른 일정이 뭐였는지 다시 정리하느라 고생한 적이 있습니다. 이참에 연인끼리 캘린더를 공유해서 서로 일정도 알고 챙겨주자해서 같이 시작했습니다. 평소 일정을 물어보지 않아도 캘린더 등록 알람으로 상대방 일정이 추가된 것을 실시간으로 알 수 있고, 까먹으면 캘린더 들어가서 확인할 수도 있었습니다. 
연인끼리 서로 가능한 날짜를 한눈에 볼 수 있어 데이트날짜 정하기 편하고, 간단하게 서로의 일정을 알 수 있어 이전대화내역 뒤져보는 귀찮음도 없고 불안하지도 않습니다. 
사용하다보니 연인뿐만 아니라 각종 모임에서도 매우 유용할 것 같습니다. 
저는 운동, 개인 목표달성과 관련된 캘린더를 추가로 만들어 사용하고 있습니다. 연인/러닝모임/달성기록 등 각각의 캘린더를 동시에 겹쳐서 한눈에 볼 수도 있고, 원하는 캘린더만 지정해서 볼 수도 있습니다.

title: Request to add a "Filter by Event Label View”
text:
Hello to whom this may concern,

I love TimeTree and how it's able to transform workplace and family accountability/tracking. I just wanted to make a request for the user experience if the team can make a "Filter View by Event Label".  Essentially the main issue we are running into is while we make use of all the labels and their color management, there will be times when the calendar itself is flooded. We use the calendar for our appointments, meetings, trainings, important events, outreach, classes, and Holidays. It would benefit both your team and the users who already love the app if there was a way to customize your own viewing experience. For example, if I only wanted to see events that are red, there would be a way to only see the red events and not the blue, grey, yellow, pink etc. Just a thought that would make a really awesome paid/subscriber feature.

title: Best Calendar App
text: I have a big family with five kids ranging from baby to preteen. My older kids are active in multiple sports. My husband and I also have different activities we do. For example, he coaches middle school football. This is the best calendar app I’ve tried, and the only one that I found that truly works for our family. Some features I love are the ability to scan images, add attachments, add addresses via a map, and assign users. I can add all relevant event details in one place. I also love the ability to toggle different calendars.  I have one calendar for events, one calendar for meal planning, one calendar for finances, that tracks bills, expenses, and paydays. Being able to toggle calendars means that I can see I have a full day of little kid doctor appointments, followed by running around to get older kids to activities, and maybe my husband also has something on his plate, so I can also toggle and see that somebody gets paid that day, and can put dinner pickup on the meal plan. This app seriously is a lifesaver- and allows us to structure our finances and lives efficiently. The only thing I would change is, I wish we could have slightly more users. title: Date selection

Often times, I have to edit my event almost immediately because, let’s pretend it is January 1, and I want to add somebody’s birthday to my calendar for January 22.

title: Completely useless with iPhones/iOS
text:
I replaced my FitBit with a Fossil smart watch, and WearOS + Google Fit have been absolute garbage. I should explain that I bought this watch because I love Fossil’s products, but before I even bought it I double-checked to be sure Wear OS would work with iPhones. It claimed that it does (this is a lie), so I felt comfortable with my purchase at the time. Since then, Wear OS and Google Fit have been nothing but a complete disappointment. Fit will not record steps either on my watch or my phone, even after doing a factory reset (this seems to be a common problem regardless of the platform if the Wear OS help forum is any indication). There are a ton of features in Wear OS that are Android-compatible only. I can’t get texts or calls on my watch. The moon phase and sunrise/sunset option don’t work unless it’s connected to a network, which is completely stupid since those are based on time and date, which are already in the watch to begin with. I would think they should maybe only have to sync once a week to keep accurate. Both Wear OS and Fit are aggravatingly limited in their functions: Fit is stupidly basic and doesn’t have things like nutrition or period tracking. Wear OS doesn’t give you any options to alter watch settings through the app, except to change the watch face, which you can also do on the watch, so really, why bother? Long story short, I have a really fancy watch that doesn’t work at all for any of the purposes I bought it for, but hey, it looks cool. I’m going back to my FitBit for health tracking.

Google, fix your s**t. This is unacceptable.

title: Weakest Link
text: I have a good Fossil watch, Google Fit works well. Wear OS just can’t remain stable. It crashes when I start it. When I restart it, it freezes. On the watch, it drains the battery when I’m not active. Every now and again, it syncs my Fit sessions. It needs some love for the iOS platform. If it’s offered on iOS despite it being an Android product, the best effort should be made.

LOVE this app. I'm so bad at remembering to take my meds and this has helped exponentially. Great app, could be better. The update doesn't allow you to immediately see your medication calendar. Go to general settings, change home screen view to pillbox. Exit. Right off the bat you are prompted to create an account without any indication that you can just skip that part. I find that kind of marketing to be a serious turn off in any app. I do like that you can notes on what each med is for and enter specific treatment durations if needed. There are a ton of useful settings, yet to decide if paying for premium would be worth it.

Used to work great, but now the reminder doesn't really work. It goes off an hour or two after my alarm is set, or sometimes not at all. And when it does go off, I'll get repeat alarms after having dismissed the reminder for the day. Tried to stick with this app as I had successfully used it for many months, but can't afford to be missing my meds. While it was working, it was a great way to keep track of everything. Would try again if it got fixed.

While the app itself appears to be useful, I am not a fan of the recurring subscription payment model, particularly for software/apps. Too many companies and services are moving to this model and it is becoming difficult to manage a maintain a reasonable budget with so many recurring fees to manage. So, provide a one-time license fee and I would consider purchasing your app, but I will not sign up for yet another recurring subscription service. I have enough of those already, thank you. In all due fairness, however, thank you for at least providing a free version.

I have always struggled to take my medicine everyday. I love the reminders and the calendar. So tired of having whatever else I'm doing interrupted with reminders I've already dismissed as taken. As nearly as I can tell, "dismiss" has precisely the same effect as "snooze". So helpful! Very user friendly and has many different options to set reminders to your liking (ex: how many reminders, whether reminders pop up on screen, etc). I used to forget to take my meds frequently, but this app helps me keep on top of it and I have rarely missed any doses since I started using it. Even if I dont take my medicine right when the alarm goes off, I have it set to remain on my notifications tab, and therefore everytime I go to use my phone I see the reminder. Great feature!

This app is so helpful 90% of the time! The bummer is, you cannot delete multiple medications at once, so I have a lot of "medications" listed that I wish I could clean up. ALSO. The day an update rolls out, all the reminders are no longer functioning. it would be helpful to send a notification to all users when an update is happening so that they can check their reminders.

I've used this app for years, but I travel a lot for work and the time zone changes wreak havoc with the reminders for some reason. I need to take my medications at specific times every day, but when I change time zones physically (and allow the phone to auto update), the timers will stop going off or randomly change times. Many, many times now I have missed taking my medication because the timer was wrong during or after travel. It's getting unacceptable.

I have just began using the app but I must say I am more than pleased with its features. You can track not only your meds, but also refills, blood work results, etc. The list is to big to cover all of the features, available for free ( yes, FREE). If you have any level of forgetfulness about takings medications on time, this app is a must have......As a healthcare provider myself, I would highly recommend this app to my own clients without hesitation.

I do really like this app. It's great that you can add dependants so they can have their meds listed separately. I just have a couple of issues. The first one is really not ok, IMO. I'd like the option to have notifications sent when it's safe to take more medication that I only take on an as needed basis. Example being migraine meds I'm able to take every 6 hours.

I used this when my cat was sick and needed to take four different meds on various schedules. I was able to easily add the info and keep track of everything. The notifications were annoying enough to remind you it was time, but easy to dismiss or reschedule if necessary. I can see how it would have been very useful when my kids were younger and everyone was on different meds for different ages at different times and amounts.

The app is very good, and I love the addition of the health trackers especially the blood pressure. However, the graphing function on the blood pressure tracker needs to be improved. It doesn't seem to make much sense to go up to 580 for the graph. As far as I know someone will be dead well before they hit that blood pressure. And having a graph access that goes that high obscures the changes day to day in blood pressure. So that's a change request, I love to see happen, thanks for this app.

this app is AWESOME!! I have the hardest time remembering to take my heart medication at night and so I was taking it really really late and it was making it super hard to get up in morning and making me super fatigued and depressed. but this app will send you a text, you can snooze it like an alarm clock ..... AND you can pick somebody like a safety net to send them a reminder if you don't click that you've taken your meds!!! and it's FREE!!!!

I have to delete it and re-enter it to get the every number of days option because it's greyed out when I go to edit the existing med. 3) Not worth paying a subscription. I'd pay a one-time fee, but with the issues above, it's simply not worth another monthly bill.

It is very helpful in keeping track of your meds; not only times to take them, but also the ones that are once a month, take as needed, etc. But it's a memory (correction - battery) hog. Too intrusive. A simple notification is enough. When a reminder is due, it opens the entire app over whatever you are doing. You can't quickly swipe it away. You have to skip meds or snooze it. Completely keeps track of when you do and don't take your meds. It even knows when you missed them when you had your device off and turn it back on. This app is simple enough that anyone can setup their meds, schedule the times and/or days when they should be taken or setup as needed, or recorded when taken without a schedule. Has stopped working for me after years of reminding me to take my meds. No matter how many times I clear data, run updates, and force stop the app and restart it, I barely ever get my reminders. I like the fact that the reminder stays "open" until I mark it as "taken", "snoozed", or "skipped". I also like the variety of snooze times available. My only disappointment is that since I changed phones the audible notification is not working as well as it did on my previous phone.

This is a pretty comprehensive app to help person not to forget taking medication especially I have several medication to take on a 24 hrs cycle. Without this app, I have to lay the entire complicated schedule on a piece of paper. It could be a challenge for someone who is not used to creating schedules. The only thing I do not like is I need to create an account with them in order to save the schedule. This is why I take out 1 star.

This takes a little bit of time for set up, but not bad. It even allows me to list eye drops with a picture of the type of container they are in. The app is especially helpful in reminders when medications are varying times of day (once a day, twice a day, three times a day...). I especially like the pause feature for those times that I'm not able to take my meds at that moment. I can reset it for a later time and still get reminded. Great, user friendly app!

This is a great little app that does one thing and one thing well. No extra annoying ads or extra fluff. And its free to use. This was recommended by my Dr. I You put in your meds and then the time you are supposed to take it. It goes off exactly when needed. The sound reminder is the sound of pills shaking in a plastic bottle It would be nice if you could put a custom sound or snooze time but the options offered are perfectly functional. Thanks for letting us use this app.

This is the best medication app I have found. Thank you, keep up the good work. To put medications in it asks for how many doses you have, which is fine, that's one way to keep up with it. But it would be great if there was another option to keep up with it by entering the date filled & # of doses in the Rx refill. Also it would be great if there was a place to keep up with other medical supplies like diabetic test strips, needles, pen tips, testosterone needles, alcohol swabs, etc.

this app used to be great. now it sends missed medication reminders to medifriends daily, even if checked off on time. in addition, the setting to remove a medifriend/change medifriend settings has disappeared or is so buried that it's impossible to find. and the online instructions are extremely out of date and therefore useless. i have recommended this app to probably 20+ people over the years. no more.

This app is just what I was looking for. You can add all your medications and put in dosing and times you want to take them. It allows you to click 'take' when you take them. Then you know you haven't missed any. The app notified you when it is time for a medication. I took off one star just because the app really drains my phone battery. I used to go all day without having to charge my phone. now I need to charge middayw ith the app running.

Great app but needs more common functionality like emergency contacts, and exporting to csv. However the one thing that should be added most of all is being able to schedule more then one alarm for blood sugar. Most people test 3-4 times a day sometimes more it would be nice if this app supported that. If it did this would be 5 stars. Also if it could track food intake for diabetics or people on diets that would be cool and seems pretty standard for similar apps.

I've used this app for a few years. It's mostly been great. I'm really hating the new "updates" section. It's constantly showing a number when there's nothing new to see. And now I won't know when there's updated info on my meds 😕 I removed the "for you" section because the info was irrelevant to my conditions. No one with the app seems to look at these reviews. People are reporting things that you could help them find, features that ARE part of the app that they're not finding or understanding

Using this app has helped me remember to take doses when I put it off (snooze option), helps me aim to do better when it tells me my overall results for the week, and gives many options for why I choose to skip or cannot take a dose. I've definitely been able to take my pills more regularly and remember that I've taken them. This app also includes some informative videos about what I'm taking too. I can't wait to see where this app goes in the future, but even if it stays the same, I'm happy.

Worked perfectly for the first few weeks, then started to take pills late and or miss them due to a pop up that stated " looks like you missed a notification, did you want to fix it" and when you choose "fix" they want you to pay up. I get it, they need to make there money, but don't offer it for free then hold you hostage with your pill reminders. I found another reminder that works perfectly

Really works well. I am horrible at remembering my meds. The rattling pill box reminder tone is perfect. Can't mistake it for anything else. Update 9/23/19, Still using this app. I haven't found anything better. If you can't remember taking your meds, look on the app. Want info on your meds? It will give you that also. Still depending on this app since 2/2016.

Works Great! I recently had a medical situation the required me taking several medicines at different times with differing expectations. I was overwhelmed and tried several other options including another app. All failed! Downloaded this app and I was amazed! I never missed a pill or got confused about when to take what. Bonus: notification wakes me when I'm sleeping which was extremely important for pain management. I love it! I've told at least 5 people and it's only been 5 days... lol!

I've given up on this app. I believe the devs and customer service are caring and try to be helpful. But, I'm now on my third phone in a row over years and multiple Android versions where this app consistently fails to provide notifications. It's a complete roulette. I've disabled optimization, given it every permission, locked it so it can't be swiped closed, no task killer, open at the start of every day to make sure it's open, and it still doesn't stay on. It's not my phone model obviously.

It's a VERY good app. So why only 3 stars? Because I only opted to pay for the premium to get the premium features for dependents. The premium features are not available for dependents accordimg to the company (I comtacted them via email...I assumed it was a glitch). That COMPLETELY devalues the app SIGNIFICANTLY for me. Especially since it is a very easy feature to make available for all dependents (from the coding perspective). I almost rated it lower because of my disappointment.

Truly excellent app. Just created login to move to new phone and it worked flawlessly. I take supplements five times a day and would not remember if it weren't for something like this! I love how it is not intrusive like an alarm, the sound is clever, sounds like a pill bottle shaking! I can't say enough grade about this app and have recommended it to others!

Make sure you create an account! Apparently even if you pay for the service it doesn't automatically have you create an account. I used this for a couple of months having paid $40 for a year. Got a new phone and apparently have now lost everything and am out the money - because there is no account registered to my email address. My only option now would be to create it all over (managing for 4 people) and actually create an account which is a separate process, and then pay again.

I've used this app for about 6 months now. It's the BEST way I've been able to rememeber my medications in years. I absolutely love it. Not only does it help me rememeber to take them, my husband is connected to my account and can also monitor what I'm taking. I do wish the price to upgrade was only a one time cost though and the cost for an entire year was a little cheaper. However with as great as this app has been for me, I'm seriously debating the upgrade anyway. Thank you!

As much as I love this app, it does feel like it's geared towards the older generation. I would love if the for you tab was customizable and gave information that was more tailored to you. I also frequently struggle with trying to find the condition I'm taking medication for, with the exception of my antidepressants. I do love that I can track my cat's meds and connect with others with the app to make sure they're taking their meds, though.

This is now an updated review. As I've used this app for about 5 years or so, now the quality and usefulness have changed. The reason I continue to use it is because of health issues that have caused memory problems, it isn't easy to relearn the use of a new app. This app frequently changes the days on me by going forward or back by a week or days. Although I have the same app on a tablet, the alarm will continue to ring even after I've stopped it on my phone. Confusing!

I thought that this app was doing everything I needed it to. I was wrong. I was fooled because it has an export feature. The problem is that the export feature is crippled to usability by not even including such basic information as the amount of medication taken (it will show the dosage strength of your medication , but not how much you took-- 1 pill or 3 pills, for example). Most of your data is locked away in the app and there's no way to access it except as a poorly formatted uneditable pdf file where parts of the text writes over other parts of the text. If this app ever goes away, all the information about how I managed my illness in these months will be gone.

I jumped on this app almost from its release and I really enjoy it. I have to take medication at three odd times during the day and this really helps me keep track. I have used it for quite a few years now and through all if the updates, it has become a very useful app. If you need help remembering to take your meds, this is the so you need.

Subscription payments should only be for apps that require cloud services, not a simple alarm app with a customized snooze button for time. On my Pixel 5, the medication reminder would frequently not sound even though I disabled battery conservation for the app, so I ended up having to set a 2nd alarm in Android anyways using built-in functions. I don't use any other features, since chemists refill meds automatically anyways. There really is no point in using this app anymore. Greedy developers.

This app does everything you need it. You can change the notification sound with the free version, cause the default is annoying! It's like a bag of change shaking VERY loud. I was disappointed that you can change the theme color on the free version. There's one thing they could of added. A way to just add a medication that you take as needed.

This is a very basic med tracker that can set very simple reminders but only works for a single ongoing medication that never changes dosage. It is terrible for managing multiple medications and varying dosages. The app constantly overwrites manual dosage amounts, deletes future doses, and requires constant monitoring to make sure the schedule is correct. That defeats the purpose. Also very clunky to use. I only used the free version but I certainly wouldn't buy it .

This app has good features but a critical problem. When you're looking at the list of meds it does not tell how many pills to take each time. It's even omitted from the report for the doctor. Less critical there's no way to specify different doses for days of the week or repeat once every 13 weeks. You can't turn off reminders without declaring the med is inactive. I will not continue to use this app. Did not like ads with sound.

Covid not listed??? Yes I know it's SARS but how many people know that? Update: back to 5 stars a lot of issues I was having with crashing and things going missing and coming back has been resolved. I'm the past, I had a lot of trouble with medications that had to be reduced over time like steroids. Today, I found it much easier to enter the information in and it was less confusing and reduced possible user error. So kudos to the developers for listening! It's a great app!

This is the best app I've used for managing my meds so far. And I've used...many. It has most of the features I need and the pill bottle shaking sound for the notifs always grabs my attention, when I am usually able to tune out my phone's default notif sounds. That said, whenever I get med reminders, open the app to mark the pills, and check off the ones I took, the app sends another reminder notif after every. Single. Med. That's a lot of pill shaking sounds 😅 Probably a bug.

It takes a bit of work to understand how to set up and use all of the benefits it offers, but once you get the hang of it and use the support offered which is very responsive, it's very good. The age demographics who would be heavy users of meds dont usually correspond with being tech savvy- my problem. I found that when I contacted support, they were quick to respond and followed up to be sure I was ok with my problem and had solved it. THAT was awesome! I've used it over 2 years and I have a number of medications I need to keep on top of and this is a really good tool.

Great app, except the notification to take meds. Notifications overrides whatever I am doing and puts the app on top, including the phone app. ( missed a couple of calls because there was no answer button to push on the screen ) I want the option to choose how I'm being notified fo take meds.. I can remember to look at the schedule myself. But love that I can backtrack when I actually took my meds...

Very good application, especially when you have to take multiple medications and I love that it has refill reminders so that I can get to the pharmacy before my meds run out since not all of my meds are on the same schedule. I can't always remember all of my meds when I go to see a medical professional so having the application to open and show them is great also.

I just installed the free version. It's promising & pretty good so far, with an apparent glitch -- I'd entered the time for one med incorrectly. When I tried to edit that med's time (it took me a bit to realize how to do that), I tapped on the time and entered the new time using the pop-up number pad. It wouldn't take. Eventually I tried editing the time by scrolling the number. Then the edit took. I'd like to switch the created pill schedule from the default profile named "Guest" to a new profile I created with the name of the individual the meds are for, but haven't yet figured out how or if that's possible.

Been using app for a year now and been great until now. Constantly asking me to subscribe to a premium version. Biggest problem I just discovered. My home power was out for 24 hours from storm. I received reminders but unable to mark I took because no WiFi. App said could not use my cell data to log taken. This is serious problem as not always at home with WiFi. Looking for new med reminder app that works anywhere without WiFi

I was enjoying this app but that's no option to have an every other day dosage and, when I take the time to completely delete the doses on days I don't need the medication, the reminders still show up as if they were never deleted. This had happened several times, so I'm in the hunt for a more versatile pill reminder app. (I have no problem paying for apps that work but I have no way of knowing if this is addressed in the paid version of this app.)
