I've been using this for meds after major surgery. For the most part, it's great, but some things are frustrating. If I take a dose late, I have to reschedule that med completely. Since I've been on very heavy pain meds, I had a lot of trouble figuring out how to do it(multiple times). It should offer to do it automatically. Also, it should give more options to customize when you take meds. There should be the option to pick any # of times per day. I needed every 5 hours, but there's only 4 & 6

I've used Medisafe for several years and it's helped tremendously with keeping me on track with my meds. It's an extremely flexible app, much much more than My Therapy or others I've tried. It includes many features to choose from so that there is something to fill every need. I agree with other reviewers that custom organizing of the list on the Medications tab would be helpful, as well as an option to separate out OTCs into another list, and please add a red bar at the top for drug allergies.

I really like this app as I tend to forget my meds without a reminder. However, the app has recently begun to give me reminders for my bedtime meds an hour after I take my evening meds and/or an hour before bedtime. I hope this will be fixed soon. This is a great app to keep track of prescriptions, their doses, and times to take them. **For the past week, alerts have been early by half an hour to an hour. Today an alert was two hours early. Please fix. -12/22/21

Medisafe is a solid pill/time keeper that has kept me on track for the past several months now. The scheduler seemed a bit difficult at first, trying to change a dosage from one time period to another, but I have figured it out, eventually. I take 9 different Rx daily, 19 pills over 4 periods, so I own up to the complexity that is expected to be managed here. I can not imagine not having a good rx tracking app now.

Great for tracking and reminders. I take a medication every other week and I don't have the best memory, so this app dutifully reminding me - more than once - on the day I'm due is immensely helpful. This might sound trivial since I could just set up reminders via several other methods instead, but this is easy and works.

Still exhibits the same very-slow-to-launch problem as before. But now a new problem cropped up in the spate of recent upgrades. A couple of times I've taken meds later than the scedule which for me is OK. But now the app thinks I want to be reminded at the NEW time. I don't; I want the original schedule to be followed even if I do take (and mark the meds as taken) an hour late. Uninstalled

You can choose to manually enter the time a medication was taken which is exactly what I was looking for. Prescribed and OTC meds as well as supplements are in the database. Reminders can be turned off. Multiple profiles for family or children can be set up too. You don't need to set up an account to start using the application either. The app provides medication interactions and side effects. There are many other free options in this app. It is easy to navigate.

I have been using this app for a long time and really depend on it. I paid for the premium features not because I need them but to pay them for their work. There is one constant bug in my Android app that causes a consistent crash however I have learned to navigate around it. I do wish there was a way to hide previous meds from view when adding a dose. I have to scroll a lot to find the one I need to add for the day due to my history with the app. Thanks again for a great product!

Love it perfect for reminding me of my medicine, and the trackers are the best for watching my bad days and better days. Would definitely recommend as a maintenance app so that you can have discussions with your Drs. And especially that you can share with friends to keep each other on track. Absolutely love it best one I've found so far

I have used this app for 4 years now. It is extremely helpful in keeping up with my list of medications, pill counts, updates on when I need refills, and keeping track of notes and measurements for my doc. An understated feature that deserves credit is the app notifying my trusted contacts in case I fall behind on medications. I highly recommend this app to anyone trying to track their health status and especially to anyone whom takes medications or supplements.

I'd give it zero stars if it let me. I'm going to download an app that actually reminds me to take my medication. Not one that reminds me maybe once or twice a week then gives a message saying, (Im paraphrasing) --- 'Oops, looks like you didn't get reminders. Want to fix with instructions that don't work or don't apply?' Nah. I only have like three apps on my phone to begin with and none of them are keeping this one from working. Just your regular phone alarm would be better than this app.

Great features, and easy to set up - easier if you use the few select pharmacies that can import your scripts. if not, then your only option is manual mode. Also, not everything I am prescribed is listed - like specific doses of vitamins. Feels like a lot of effort to set up, but the reminders are useful. 5 stars when it works with Kroger's brands of pharmacies and an inclusive database. But.I will keep using it in hopes that soon these issues will be remedied.

This app will drive you crazy with persistent reminders until you tell it when you take your medications. If you need reminders, AND if you will honestly record when you do and do not take them, this app will keep you on track. UPDATE: An additional reminder has been added. "Did you take your meds today?". This notification can not be shut off or set to go off at the user's convenience, as far as I can tell. It has awakened me repeatedly, or interrupted at inconvenient times.😖

I use two medication reminders as a double back up for myself, and really like how this one keeps me on track. Easy to mark when I've taken it. Only thing I'd change is that sometimes the option to mark as taken from the notification bar disappears and I have to open the app and do a few more clicks, but otherwise it's great!

I have never seen an app that can't handle a simple reminder. I love the idea of this app - but the inability for both caregiver and user to be involved with managing case and care, is ridiculous. What is far worse that that, though, is that this app promises to remind you to take your medication and then doesn't. First, weirdly, I would only get the notifications if I were connected to my PC at the time, then they stopped all together. My medications are time sensitive - this is dangerous! 😡

My body is broken, and I take 6 meds and many supplements. This app reminds me to take them in the middle of the day when I am busy. I have had a couple of days where it went off 15 minutes early or late but that's the only problem I've had. I do wish it would follow the phones clock and change time zones automatically.

Medisafe has become an indispensable tool in helping me take my meds both on time and consistently. Prior to using it I touch and go with taking my meds simply because I'd forget, but since I downloaded it it's gotten so much easier. Additionally, the ability to store information on my meds in the app is very helpful, good for talking with a doctor!

I do like this app. Iffy at first, but really grown to like it, once discovering how much information it can provide on your medications and ease of entry. Plus, can keep track of many other health records. Plus what I do like, when it reminds time to take a dose, it reminds gently (but persistently) without shock. It got 4 stars instead of 5, because for all the really cool (and fun) features it is a bit pricey each month, but... More I use I'll probably end up upgrading to 5 stars.

The app is helpful. It would benefit me more if the app could be more flexible instead of having a set schedule. For example, I have a medication since my surgery that needs to be taken every 4 hours. I had to create a rigid schedule for this but what if I don't wake up every day at the same time. I may wake up at 6 one day or 9 another. The app should be intuitive enough to tell me in 4 hours from my last dosage that it is time for another.

I've been using this app for years with no problems until recently. The folks at Medisafe responded quickly and my issues were resolved with a simple reinstall. I had forgotten my data was backed up in the cloud and was afraid to uninstall. Fantastic app and planning to stick with it as nothing else even comes close to what it does and the developers really care about what they are putting out. Thanks again. 😁👌

Generally good.accurate reminders as I set them. One additional feature I would like is to limit the number of times the app reminds me of refills. Currently, I get reminders multiple times each day until I refill. A setting of, "Remind me once" or, "Remind me once per day" would be a welcome addition.

Used to be good, not anymore. If I snooze a medication for X amount of minutes, the app will stop giving notifications indefinitely. I have to manually open the app myself to see if I missed or already took my medication, which is extremely unreliable and does the opposite of what it's supposed to do. it's utter trash now.

It's actually the best one out of all of them, except for the alarm. I was under the impression the reminder/alarm part of the app was free, and was really surprised that alarm notification choices were only available with a paid version. I don't keep my phone on me 24/7, and I can't always hear the little pill bottle shaking, so I had to uninstall it. It's too bad, because I liked everything about it - especially the real time given under the scheduled time for taking a pill, and likely would have ended up buying it, but I was very put off by the alarm restriction. I simply couldn't always hear it. Great app, though.

It was working well for a while, but then I got a bunch of new meds and needed 4 reminders a day, and it stopped working. When I needed it most, it stopped alarming. I set it to always alarm even if the volume was down and always pop up and it didn't do either anymore at all. I had to switch to a new, less pretty app with boring alarm tones. So disappointed. Edit: I came back to this app again in 2025 (previous review was from 2016) and it works fine again.

UPDATE_2 The app is working beautifully! No more crashing. Kudos to the team! UPDATE ***4/30/19 do not install today's update for Android. application crashes everytime I open. sent email to support, and will report on the results.*** Great app to help me keep meds sorted properly. It's easy to use with little to no set up and no need to read the directions. I decided to subscribe for the premium to support the development team which has created an elegant simple and effective application.

This is the best thing for those with several prescriptions, taken at different times of the day. Also if you have memory problems this is GREAT!!!! You can set it up with different sounds or voices to make it more fun. Taking medication can be so dreadful and this app allows u to a little personality to it. My physicians LOVE it. Good luck👍🏼👍🏼👍🏼

I scheduled two times each day. I should have scheduled three times each day. The display still just shows twice per day although I do get three reminder alarms. The icon on the "cover" page frequently has a 1 on it. I think that indicates that I've missed taking my meds. But going to the medsafe tally page the indication is that I have taken my meds. Overall, using this app has been a help. Even with some erroneous displays, it has prevented me from missing.

This app is really easy to use and I figured out that if you can't find your symptom on the list of health trackers, you can just edit the name after adding it to your list. The med tracker works really well. I only wish that it showed you a weekly or monthly view of your symptom levels so you could have a better idea of what might cause your ups and downs. But if your just needing to keep track of meds and monitor a few symptoms then I recommend this app. I'm using the free version.

This is a very helpful app that I have used for over a year now. It's very pushy and intrusive, which is exactly what I need to remember to take all this medication. The only 2 problems I have are that it will pop up too soon when I've snoozed an alarm, and also it pops up over my phone when I'm driving. It also pops up over my lock screen, which isn't optimal.

I have used this app for many years. I have had several TBI's and this app has been there for me to remind me when to take my meds. My docs love it cause I can show them or ramble off my list of meds for them. Some have shared with their patients even. It is relatively easy to use & update. Also has a friend reminder so someone else can remind you too. I love the tracker system in it so I am able to look back & see what meds I have missed. Able to track docs & refills even. Best app ever!

The only thing that could improve is if it would show on the pop up notification what the medication is that's due (since sometimes meds are taken at the same time). That said, it's not a big inconvenience because of how the process works! This app is very well made, and the developers definitely have the user in mind as everything is majorly convenient! Yes there's a paid plan I believe, but the free version has everything needed and then some, including customization. Very nice app!

After using a couple of the top star apps. This one, Medisafe is so intuitive and forgiving. Sometimes you can't take the meds at the time you are supposed to, other times you need to stagger them. This app not only helps you do it, it makes it easy to get back on track. With the history, your Dr. Can see what meds you are having an issue with. The notes lets you... make notes on a particular issue to talk with your Doctor about. The timer for the meds is easy.

Love this app! I've recommended it to some family members and two of us are connected. The only suggestion I have is to enable a separate volume control. If my phone's on vibrate, I miss my afternoon dose, so having this app override my setting (like my alarm clock does), would be especially useful.

Completely user friendly. No bugs. No ads. Great notification system for dosages. I like the ability to suspend meds from schedule when desired. Edit 2023: started using this app again (didn't think I needed it for a while) and it's still glitch-free and awesome. So versatile. I swear they're not paying me for this review lol!

Pretty good, some disappointing unavailable features.. android app cannot ignore do not disturb mode like every other alarm app on the market. This was crucial after my surgery as I didn't want to be bothered by all the other notifications on my phone, only a reminder to take meds. Had to use another alarm app to make sure I woke up to take meds.

Update June 2020: The developers took care of most annoyances. I'm glad I have Medisafe to help with my complicated medication schedule. Original 2016 Review: It is cute how it shows the pills four quarters of a circle for night, morning, afternoon and evening. However, the size of the pill icons is pretty small and this makes it difficult to operate the app. Also, there does not seem currently to be a way to preemptively pause notifications for a while. You can set the snooze time but that's not the same. Sometimes I'm out for the evening and cannot take my medicine until I'm back home. I'd like to pause notification for a set number of hours, but I can't. I'm also not fond of the "Updates" screen.

I originally gave five stars because it was a very useful app for keeping track of all my medications. I've used it for over a year. But after a recent update it started alerting me to take all my medications at times that I don't have them scheduled, even old meds that I had turned off. I ended up deleting all my old meds thinking it would help, but I'm still getting alerts for them every day. I've uninstalled and reinstalled, deleted and readded meds. I'm at a loss. Sadly uninstalling now.

I'm sure if I took pills less frequently the notifications would be less annoying, but that's not the app's fault. I started using this app when I needed to take a pill every 6 hours, which isn't that easy to comply with when you're still working most of your life at an 8-5 job in multiple locations. The reminders after helpful. And the pharmacist videos explaining drug effects and interactions would also be helpful, particularly if my medications were in a phase of change.

This app is easy to use and overall, I love it. I think one of my favorite features is being able to create a custom icon for each medication. However, I'm knocking off a star because the notification sound for this is so annoying. It's an obnoxiously loud and aggressive pills-rattling-in-bottle sound. My rage levels go from 0-100 whenever I hear it. Please, I'm begging, change the sound.

This is a very good app it makes keeping track of your medications easy. One upgrade to make it better would be to track when you need to get the prescription renewed. Right now all it does is notify you when you need to refill the medication. Another thing they could do is track infusions. I get an infusion every 6 months.

Not bad, good options for counting pills and marking times taken. Getting an error "try again later" when trying to add more than one medication, consistently. If that is a limit of the free version they should more clearly state it. Alarms sometimes ready to miss but that seems to be Android problem and not the fault of this app.

I don't know how I would survive without this app! My original rating was in 2016 when I first got the app, now I have been on and off so many medications, my weight has fluctuated, my pain level is fluctuating, and my blood pressure is going up. All that being said ? THIS APP IS THE BOMB! Through all these changes it has helped me keep track. I am so grateful, thank you for inventing this!

Counterintuitive app, very slow and hard to set up. It focuses more on up selling additional products and services than to actually allow you to navigate the one you've got. In general the app gives you pretty much what you expect. However only after you created an account and after you agreed to provide all the data. Recently got the body+ scale, which seems good at its job. But I don't like the app. Please let me opt out of badges! I'm not 10, and this isn't a game for me. I also made the mistake of connecting to health connect, which would have been fine if this was my main app that I was going to use for all my health information, but I only have 1 scale from you and I wish to only use this app for that, and not be drowned in some information it managed to pull through health connect that I can't delete.

I wanted to test Withings because an other app I used, 8fit, is discontinued, and it is integrated in Withings. I tried Withings, decided it was not for me, checked that I had cancelled it (the mail I had said 0 kr in payment), and forgot about my trial period. Now I have suddenly paid for a whole year. The app I now have does not have the excellent recipies, meal planning or easily accessible exercise programs from 8 fit. I can't reach a person to cancel it, and the AI does not understand.

The app is good for the most part. My only complaints are with setup and viewing data in the graphs. During setup: when trying to connect the scale, the screen says "Looking for your scale" and tells you to "Turn on your scale" - which I thought I did given that the screen lights up, when in actual fact it requires you too HOLD down the the button on the back to connect it. The screen should just say that. With the graphs: while viewing something like weight over time, when switching the tabs from week, to month to year, and back to week again - the app doesn't focus back to the current week automatically. It just spreads back out into the week view, which ends up focusing somewhere months ago even if there is no data to show. Otherwise the app works fine. I'd like to be able to set goals other than just weight e.g. goals for losing body fat or gaining muscle mass.

The app tries to tell me that I've done something wrong when pulse wave velocity doesn't register. Huge variability in readings taken in immediate succession - I can lose or gain hundreds of grammes of fat or muscle in less than a minute, apparently. It leaves me feeling quite angry a lot of mornings, which isn't a great way to start the day.

Edit: 0/10 DO NOT BUY WITHINGS. Now 2 years into owning my Withings scale. In that time the app has remained a consistent 1 star. The most obvious issues with the app continue to be ignored. Standing on the scales does not automatically send information to the app. There's no way to force this, so if you're looking to quickly check statistics, you're unable to do so, as you are limited to when the app syncs. The app continues to make it difficult to view results based off any timeline. Junk.

Update March 2026: not used this for a few months but trying again for the last week or so. Worked perfectly for the first day, then got the latest update. App is going backwards with every update.
